d: Roopa Panesar is one of the most distinguished sitar players in the UK who started learning from Dharambir Singh, she trained further with Ustad Shahid Parvez, Bahauddin Dagar and Arvind Parikh and also fine-tuned her musical appreciation under the tutelage of vocalist Pandit Ajoy Chakraborty. This presentation is from her live performance at the Darbar Festival 2021.
